description:
The process begins when a company identifies the need for a new supplier or vendor.
The procurement team issues a request for proposals (RFP) and receives responses from various suppliers.
Each proposal is evaluated based on criteria like cost, quality, and delivery time.
The team may also conduct site visits or interviews with suppliers.
After careful analysis, a supplier is selected, and contract negotiations begin.
Once both parties agree on the terms, the contract is signed.
The process ends when the supplier is officially onboarded, and the contract is executed.
generated_bpmn_xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/supplier-selection">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_RFP" name="Request for proposals"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Proposal" name="Supplier proposal"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Terms" name="Contract terms"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_SupplierSelection">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Company" name="Company" processRef="Process_SupplierSelection"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Suppliers" name="Suppliers"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_RFP" name="Issue RFP" sourceRef="Task_IssueRFP" targetRef="Participant_Suppliers" messageRef="Message_RFP"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Proposal" name="Submit proposals" sourceRef="Participant_Suppliers" targetRef="Task_ReceiveProposals" messageRef="Message_Proposal"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Terms_Out" name="Discuss contract terms" sourceRef="Task_Negotiate" targetRef="Participant_Suppliers" messageRef="Message_Terms"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Terms_In" name="Discuss contract terms" sourceRef="Participant_Suppliers" targetRef="Task_Negotiate" messageRef="Message_Terms"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_SupplierSelection" name="Select and onboard a supplier" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Process" name="Process begins"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_IdentifyNeed" name="Identify need for a new supplier or vendor"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_IssueRFP" name="Issue request for proposals"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveProposals" name="Receive supplier proposals"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_EvaluateProposals" name="Evaluate proposals based on cost, quality, and delivery time"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ConsiderVisits" name="Conduct site visits or interviews?" default="Flow_SkipVisits"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ConductVisits" name="Conduct site visits or interviews"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_VisitsMerge" name="Continue assessment"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SelectSupplier" name="Select supplier"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Negotiate" name="Negotiate contract terms"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_TermsAgreed" name="Have both parties agreed on terms?" default="Flow_TermsNotAgreed"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SignContract" name="Sign contract"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_CompletionSplit" name="Complete onboarding and contract execution"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_OnboardSupplier" name="Officially onboard supplier"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ExecuteContract" name="Execute contract"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_CompletionJoin" name="Onboarding and contract execution complete"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Process" name="Supplier onboarded and contract executed"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_Identify" sourceRef="Start_Process" targetRef="Task_IdentifyNeed"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Identify_IssueRFP" sourceRef="Task_IdentifyNeed" targetRef="Task_IssueRFP"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_IssueRFP_Receive" sourceRef="Task_IssueRFP" targetRef="Task_ReceiveProposals"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Receive_Evaluate" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveProposals" targetRef="Task_EvaluateProposals"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Evaluate_ConsiderVisits" sourceRef="Task_EvaluateProposals" targetRef="Gateway_ConsiderVisits"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ConductVisits" sourceRef="Gateway_ConsiderVisits" targetRef="Task_ConductVisits">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">siteVisitsOrInterviewsNeeded</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SkipVisits" sourceRef="Gateway_ConsiderVisits" targetRef="Gateway_VisitsMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_VisitsToMerge" sourceRef="Task_ConductVisits" targetRef="Gateway_VisitsMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Merge_Select" sourceRef="Gateway_VisitsMerge" targetRef="Task_SelectSupplier"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Select_Negotiate" sourceRef="Task_SelectSupplier" targetRef="Task_Negotiate"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Negotiate_TermsCheck" sourceRef="Task_Negotiate" targetRef="Gateway_TermsAgreed"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TermsAgreed" sourceRef="Gateway_TermsAgreed" targetRef="Task_SignContract">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">bothPartiesAgreeOnTerms</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TermsNotAgreed" sourceRef="Gateway_TermsAgreed" targetRef="Task_Negotiate"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Sign_CompletionSplit" sourceRef="Task_SignContract" targetRef="Gateway_CompletionSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_Onboard" sourceRef="Gateway_CompletionSplit" targetRef="Task_OnboardSupplier"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_Execute" sourceRef="Gateway_CompletionSplit" targetRef="Task_ExecuteContract"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Onboard_Join" sourceRef="Task_OnboardSupplier" targetRef="Gateway_CompletionJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Execute_Join" sourceRef="Task_ExecuteContract" targetRef="Gateway_CompletionJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Join_End" sourceRef="Gateway_CompletionJoin" targetRef="End_Process"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
